runtime_profile_admission.calculate_qparams: https://github.com/vllm-project/compressed-tensors/blob/525a7a7b84ebccdbc0db07956338b6f8c851d58f/src/compressed_tensors/quantization/utils/helpers.py#L80 — scale = amax / (bit_range/2); lines 114-139 replace ONLY scales == 0 with dtype epsilon (zero-only epsilon; no small-amax clamp in this pinned path)
runtime_profile_admission.activation_qdq: https://github.com/vllm-project/compressed-tensors/blob/525a7a7b84ebccdbc0db07956338b6f8c851d58f/src/compressed_tensors/quantization/lifecycle/forward_helpers.py#L168 — _quantize_dequantize divides by scale, clamps/rounds, multiplies back
runtime_profile_admission.policy: other profile versions require explicit audit before admission (producer pin is intentional)
runtime_profile_admission.fp32_note: CPU Float32 is an explicit compute profile; it does not claim bitwise BF16 producer-arithmetic parity or upstream full-model port parity

groups.layers.{0..3}: decoder layers: self_attn + multihead_attn (in_proj [3072,1024], out_proj [1024,1024]), linear1 [4096,1024], linear2 [1024,4096], norm1/norm2/norm3 [1024]
groups.evidence_layers.{0..1}: routing layers: query_norm/memory_norm/attention/feedforward_norm [1024], attention in_proj [3072,1024] out_proj [1024,1024], feedforward [4096,1024]+[1024,4096]

clef_head/joint_head.safetensors.head_completeness: inventory matches joint_head_config.json geometry (width 1024, routing_layers 2, layers 4, heads 16, feedforward 4096) and the upstream schema source module structure; verified bit-identical to the upstream original head file

provenance_evidence.lfs_files: local sha256 equals the Hugging Face LFS oid (published content sha256) at the pinned producer revision; LFS-equality vs upstream also uses LFS sha256 (tree oids of LFS entries are pointer-file hashes and are NOT compared)
provenance_evidence.regular_files: git blob sha1 (blob <size> + NUL + content) equals the tree entry oid at the pinned producer revision; upstream-equality for regular files uses git blob sha1
provenance_evidence.classification: per-file provenance.classification is authoritative; exactly 10 files are bit-identical to upstream (2 by LFS sha256, 8 by git blob sha1, including the path-remapped head weights/config), 3 have counterparts that differ by construction (quantized backbone pack, extended root config, producer README), and 8 are producer-specific with no upstream counterpart

receipts.result: 21/21 files matched at pinned producer revision by the per-file algorithms above; 10/21 bit-identical to Cloudflare/clef-flash@8b2e5fd17c09fd49bc2880b805d5323ec7ff4ff3 (head safetensors + tokenizer by LFS sha256; head config, schema source, chat template, tokenizer/processor/generation configs, LICENSE, .gitattributes by git blob sha1). Backbone root config.json is NOT identical (producer quantization config) and no equality is claimed for it.
receipts.method: offline content hashing; no model code executed
